en: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.
Speak to Pephredo at the Darkbriar Lodge in the Valley of Spirits, up above and to the west of the Valley of Strength.
Show me your grimoires.
Guards! Guards!
I do not have much time in this world, but Light willing, it is time enough to fulfill my destiny.  When you face Baron Rivendare, I will be with you.
There will be pain...
Do not push me, or I will impale you on my horns!
I tell ye, I don't miss the Great War at all. I remember when we fought at Darrowmere. All night in the fog, lying in a muddy trench.
You kept me in that cell for too long, monster!
Greetings, citizen.
What brings you to this part of the world, $n?
Don't be alarmed... while my gryphons may not be entirely whole, they will still carry you faithfully to your destination. Tell me... which tower do you seek?
I can't come down.  I am scared.
I...have...failed.
Oh dear, I am running dangerously low on supplies! What is taking that blasted goblin so long?

It is a story of legend and one that I do not have the time nor the inclination to retell. Just know that Medivh was the last of the Guardians. The greatstaff of Atiesh was a focal point of his power and a focal point of corruption.
Aku'mai demands more sacrifices, now you must die!
I have heard your words, Great Bear Spirit, and I understand.  I now seek your blessings to fully learn the way of the Claw.
Bow in my presence, insect! Surely you can feel the power I hold over you.
It was on that day that the wildkin were given to us. Fierce guardians, the goddess assigned the wildkin to protect all of her sacred places.
Even slight alterations to a potion's ingredients can change it fundamentally. Patience and precision, young one: they will serve you well in all walks of life.
Brahaha! Tha look on their faces as old Trollplow's gun came swiveling around to meet them! Their saws couldn't even touch me!
How much more blood is needed, Commander?
%s takes out a remote control and tosses down a model siege engine!
%s charges!

It... It's foggy, $N. I can't see anything! Wait... Wait a minute. I see... I see Doctor Weavil's hideout. It... YES! I believe he is holding a chapter of the book!$B$BLet me see if I can zoom this thing out to get a better vantage point.$B$B<Narain appears to be going cross-eyed.>$B$BAlcaz Island! That devious bastard is on Alcaz Island!
Let none with the foul taint of plague live!
Zoom, zing, and BAM! He may have had a huge two handed cleaver made from a boat anchor but after a few well placed slices from my dinner knife, he was the one going crash!
%s is once again at peace.
D'ah! Now you're making me angry!
Pay me and I'll talk...$B$BOh hey, it's you, $n! Nevermind about that...
%s has been encaged.
Make it fast.
